race.comment: SHADWELL LANE (8) resumes as the horse to beat after showing enough in stronger races last campaign. The Deagon trial win supports her readiness, while the Jack Bruce and Ben Thompson combination adds further confidence. CYBER CITY (4) returns is another that will be able to inject plenty of speed into the race with an inside draw to help. Is yet to strike fresh but has proven handy on his day, so is worth keeping in mind. VANZADEE (13) resumes. Freshened three months and returns to a winning trip. Can be involved in the finish. NOT TELLING (15) is back after three months off a dominant Dalby Mdn win. In the mix.
